name: Giovanni Lurani
features: olive skin, dark hair brushed back, dark eyes, long patrician face, fine features, slim build, urbane amused expression
bio: Count Giovanni ‘Johnny’ Lurani Cernuschi, VIII Count of Calvenzano — engineer, journalist and driver in roughly equal measure. Eleven Mille Miglias with class wins in 1933, 1948 and 1952, and a class win at Le Mans in 1935 in an Aston Martin Ulster. His Nibbio record car was the first 500cc machine past 100 mph. He later invented Formula Junior and helped write GT racing into the international rulebook.
